items.title: Coca-Cola pivots from divisive AI-generated ads for holiday campaign
items.excerpt: After backlash to its generative-AI holiday spots, Coca-Cola's 'Enjoy Joy' campaign returns to live-action footage of family and friends.

items.title: Walmart mulls role advertising will play in an agentic shopping world
items.excerpt: Walmart Connect momentum remains strong, but executives said AI shopping agents are changing consumer behavior and the role ads will play.

items.title: Target's AI shopping assistant is driving sales
items.excerpt: Target's beta AI assistant, Ask Target, is showing early sales success, CEO Michael Fiddelke said on the Q3 call.

items.title: Mall of America debuts AI-backed concierge, Mallie
items.excerpt: Mall of America launched Mallie, an AI digital assistant that helps shoppers plan and personalize visits ahead of the holidays.

items.title: In Graphic Detail: Welcome to the agentic commerce quarter
items.excerpt: OpenAI, Google, Amazon and Walmart are betting on agent-led holiday shopping; Digiday charts how far agentic commerce still has to go.

items.title: Measuring Clicks Is Making ChatGPT Ads Look Like A Bad Bet
items.excerpt: Incrmntal's CEO argues judging ChatGPT ads by search-style click metrics is a mistake and makes the case for incrementality measurement.

items.title: Canvas Worldwide's Agentic Layer Helps Zillow Distinguish Real Renters From Dreamers
items.excerpt: Canvas Worldwide's AI agent layer helps Zillow optimize campaign budgeting and pacing toward high-intent renters.

items.title: Philips Sonicare Polishes Its Streaming TV Strategy Using Amazon Ads Agent
items.excerpt: Philips Sonicare consolidated its streaming TV buys inside Amazon and used the Amazon Ads agent to plan and run them.

items.title: Microsoft Ads In AI Overviews on Bing
items.excerpt: Microsoft confirmed on its Advertising blog that search ads now appear in AI Overviews on Bing, after weeks of sightings.

items.title: Google Ads AI Max For Search For Travel Campaigns Help Docs
items.excerpt: Google published help docs for AI Max for Search for Travel as Hotel/Travel campaigns migrate into Search campaigns for Travel.

items.title: Google Ads AI Max Is Making More Decisions For You - 6 Settings To Audit Now
items.excerpt: As Google expands Search automation, a guide to auditing AI Max settings for unwanted queries, generated ad copy and lead quality.

items.title: InMobi lets seven AI agents run small firms' Google, Meta and ChatGPT ads
items.excerpt: InMobi Accelerate uses seven AI agents to launch and manage small advertisers' campaigns across Google, Meta and ChatGPT, reporting a 'True ROAS' figure.

items.title: HubSpot won't charge extra when Claude or ChatGPT works its CRM
items.excerpt: HubSpot says everyday CRM use from Claude or ChatGPT is covered by seats and outside agents draw on API plan limits, with credits reserved for heavy governed-agent work.

items.title: Amazon draws 24% of retailer searches but 11% of AI shopping answers
items.excerpt: Verve data shows AI assistants name Amazon in 11% of shopping answers despite a 24% search share, while Target and Walmart punch differently ahead of Black Friday.

items.title: Meta Welcomes Loblaw as First Canadian Retail Partner to Muse
items.excerpt: Loblaw brings its catalogue to Meta's Muse AI agent as a partner connector, letting Canadian shoppers plan meals and check out groceries in the agent.

items.title: Visa extends Agentic Ready to acceptance
items.excerpt: Visa opened Agentic Ready to merchants, PSPs, acquirers and commerce platforms; 140+ participants including Adyen, PayPal and Stripe test AI-agent-initiated transactions.

items.title: AI '가짜 의사' 광고 차단…소비자원, 네이버·카카오·틱톡과 맞손
items.excerpt: 한국소비자원이 네이버·카카오·틱톡과 협력해 AI로 만든 가짜 의사·유명인 부당광고를 모니터링·차단하고 반복 게재 시 플랫폼별 제한 조치를 한다.

items.title: NHN커머스, 고도몰에 AI 검색 최적화·쇼핑 에이전트 기능 도입
items.excerpt: 고도몰에 GEO와 WebMCP를 적용해 AI 에이전트가 상품 검색·장바구니·쿠폰 발급까지 15개 기능을 수행하도록 했다. 결제는 사용자가 직접.

items.title: "전통 유통 기업 아냐"...CJ올리브영, AI 앞세워 '글로벌 테크 플랫폼' 도약
items.excerpt: CJ올리브영이 첫 테크 콘퍼런스에서 AI 기반 상품 탐색·장바구니 등 에이전틱 커머스와 글로벌 수요 예측 전략을 공개했다.

items.title: [르포]AI가 주머니 사정 맞춰 구매…핀테크 '미래 커머스' 제시
items.excerpt: 싱가포르 핀테크 페스티벌에서 비자·마스터카드·스트라이프 등이 AI 에이전트가 결제 권한을 받아 스스로 상품을 구매하는 차세대 결제를 시연했다.

items.title: "마케터 97%, AI 활용 계획" 광고 업무별 실제 도입률은 30~40% 수준
items.excerpt: 마케터 97%가 AI 활용 계획을 밝혔지만 광고 업무별 실제 도입률은 30~40%에 머문다는 조사 결과.

items.title: "제품 정보 부족하면 구매 포기" 소비자 절반 이상, AI 제품 상담 이용 의향
items.excerpt: 소비자 절반 이상이 구매 전 AI 제품 상담을 이용할 의향이 있다는 조사로, 커머스 전환에서 AI 상담의 역할을 보여준다.

items.title: Snapchat enables Lens creation via third-party AI tools
items.excerpt: Snapchat's Easy Lens lets users and brands build AR Lenses through their chatbot of choice (third-party AI tools).
